requirement.statement: The Schema Editor SHALL reuse business property classifiers, transformers, and presenters through code-side scoped bindings while keeping StructureSchema and EditorPresentation serializable and business implementation free.

case.given: two editors consume the same StructureSchema field annotated as user.phone
case.when: business A and business B assemble their own Scope dialect and presenter layers
case.then: each editor SHALL render and validate its own bounded-context phone experience without changing or copying the shared schema

case.given: a bounded-context binding and an editor-instance binding target the same stable semantic or presenter id
case.when: the editor runtime is assembled with explicit later-wins composition
case.then: the editor-instance implementation SHALL apply only to that editor and SHALL NOT alter sibling Scope registries

case.given: a business editor selects a custom property presenter
case.when: its schema and EditorPresentation are inspected and contract-validated
case.then: they SHALL contain only stable ids and serializable options and SHALL NOT contain functions, components, runtime instances, callbacks, or writers

case.given: multiple editors require shared address, reference, and enum property experiences
case.when: their runtimes compose the shared business property capsule
case.then: the editors SHALL reuse the same transformer and presenter implementations without copying them into each bounded context

requirement.statement: Business property demos SHALL execute through the canonical Halfcode Schema Editor lifecycle, emit only normalized presenter events, and display only Session-accepted snapshots.

case.given: business A and B editor bundles are lowered to canonical Halfcode sources and loaded into isolated Scope runtimes
case.when: their visible property controls are rendered
case.then: both editors SHALL resolve their scoped presenter implementations through the canonical renderer without synthetic loaded bundles or a global registry

case.given: a business presenter emits a normalized value event
case.when: the ValueHost accepts, rejects, conflicts, or delays the command
case.then: the visible value SHALL advance only for a current matching accepted snapshot and SHALL remain unchanged for every other outcome

case.given: the business demo and reusable property capsule are implemented
case.when: generic package source and public surfaces are scanned
case.then: the contract, logic, support, Vue, and default Element Plus packages SHALL NOT contain business A/B policy, host writers, or demo-only service location
